author: Pixar YouTube
text:
Creators React to KINGDOM HEARTS IV Trailer | D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event
Revealed during the Disney Entertainment Showcase on August 14, 2026, KINGDOM HEARTS IV is launching in late 2027! And we got creators first reactions to the trailer.

A brand-new adventure awaits as the world of Disney and Pixar's Coco joins KINGDOM HEARTS IV.

KINGDOM HEARTS IV is now available to wishlist on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox ON PC, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

@danbotooie, @cocognzx , @jojocrichton, @erikaenchanted, and @patrickadougall
